findings.summary: A supported Bun version may return exit code 0 when a filter matches no tests, allowing declared verification to pass without executing tests.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.

missing_tests: A bun test process with exitCode=0 and no-match or zero-pass output must produce failed verification evidence.
hidden_assumptions: Bun test exit code 0 always proves at least one test executed.
